title: DART
description: Documented public deflection demonstration (NASA / Johns Hopkins APL) for the Planetary Defense Simulator capability area.
body:
DART is a documented deflection demonstration from NASA / Johns Hopkins APL. The 2022 mission that struck Dimorphos and measurably changed its orbital period — humanity's first demonstrated asteroid deflection.

How it works: It works by advancing the mean anomaly at the circular-orbit mean motion and rotating the position vector by the swept angle.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.
